criteria: Public HackerRank intern rubric (interviewstreet/hiring-agent). OSS means contributions to OTHER people's projects; personal repos score ≤10 open_source. Tutorial apps (todo, weather, calculator, basic CRUD) are low self_projects. Hacktoberfest alone is 3-5 open_source max. Bonus: GSoC +5, founder/early engineer +3-5, portfolio URL +2, LinkedIn +1. Deduct for missing project links and tutorial-only portfolios.
notes: Use for reverse-ATS against the public intern rubric. Not the default for MSP hires. Rank only. Do not auto-reject.
